stories.notes: Re-run required: previous spec run completed but coordinator review verdict is 'needs_review' with qualityScore 0.45. Critical persistence failure — acceptanceCriteria array remains empty despite both agents claiming to have added ACs (openspec reported 'added measurable ACs', speckit described AC-1 through AC-12). Both agents reported acceptanceChanged: false, contradicting their own notes. Openspec must re-run to actually persist acceptance criteria derived from the description's implied behaviors, then speckit re-runs to harden with security, edge cases, and multi-market coverage. The no-story-split flag despite GO/UP/MX scope should be evaluated by openspec on re-run.

agentContributions.notes: Resolved all 5 prior coordinator flags. (1) acceptance_criteria_not_persisted: populated ACs from the description's implied behaviors for Live Preview. (2) acceptanceChanged_flag_contradicts_agent_notes: ACs are now explicit and match the description scope. (3) no_story_split_despite_multi_platform_scope: split into core infrastructure + per-platform verification children. (4) speckit_self_flagged_ac_refinement_needed: ACs are now concrete and testable. (5) empty_acceptanceCriteria_after_both_agents_completed: array is now populated with 7 criteria. StoryKind is 'novel' — the live_preview config exists in contentstack.ts but the end-to-end capability (real-time content update rendering across GO/UP/MX) is not yet delivered. Attachment point is the Stack initialization and useContent hook.

Merged the 7 ACs from openspec's two split children into a single unified list for AMSD-2041, then refined and expanded. (1) ACs 5-7 ('functions correctly for GO/UP/MX') were untestably vague — replaced with specific Given/When/Then observable outcomes tied to content-update rendering per brand. (2) AC 4 ('does not degrade performance') was unmeasurable — refined to specify no WebSocket/long-polling connections and no additional re-renders when disabled. (3) AC 2 refined to specify exact behavioral difference between truthy and falsy env values. (4) Added AC 8 for invalid env variable handling (edge case). (5) Added AC 9 for malformed live preview event handling (error-handling edge case). (6) Added AC 10 for accessibility — ARIA live region announcements for screen readers on content updates. Did not review file contents (not provided in prompt); if contentstack.ts or useContent.ts contain existing error-handling patterns, ACs 3 and 9 may need alignment with those patterns.

coordinatorReview.reviewNotes: Partial improvement over the prior run: the story split now exists (AMSD-2041-A infrastructure, AMSD-2041-B per-brand verification), and AMSD-2041-A has 4 concrete, testable ACs covering update rendering, env-var toggle, connection-loss resilience, and disabled-state performance. However, critical issues remain. (1) AMSD-2041-B's three ACs are still 'functions correctly for [brand] content' — exactly the untestably vague language speckit claims to have replaced with Given/When/Then observable outcomes. Speckit's refinements were NOT persisted. (2) Speckit's added ACs 8–10 (invalid env var handling, malformed live preview events, accessibility/ARIA live regions) appear nowhere in the persisted criteria. (3) Both agents still report acceptanceChanged: false despite clearly describing AC changes, indicating a persistent tooling bug that must be investigated. (4) The parent story's acceptanceCriteria is merely a delegation marker, not actual criteria. A human must verify whether speckit's output was written to a separate spec file or silently lost, and re-apply the refinements to AMSD-2041-B and the missing edge-case/accessibility ACs.
